messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up — JupiterBank returned our bespoke SIG and has three urgent asks, due Fri EOD. Main items: 1) example audit-log export (JSONL) showing key rotation events and access attempts, 2) KMS rotation metadata and HSM attestation evidence (they asked for cert/letter), 3) confirmation on retention windows + a redacted export they can include in their package. They also hit a 401 while trying to download an export and included repro steps. Can eng + security advise what artifacts we can give for hosted vs dedicated?

Matt Chen: I can produce a redacted JSONL log sample. Quick Q — what exact fields do they expect in the sample? timestamps, actor, resource, event_type, request_id, result? I can scrub user IDs and IPs. @Igor any constraints on including key IDs?

Igor Kuznetsov: We should provide these artifacts but with caveats. For Hosted customers we can share rotation timestamps, key metadata (key id, creation/rotation timestamps, algorithm), and a signed attestation summary. We cannot share HSM device serials or private key material for Hosted. For Dedicated/Private we can provide an HSM attestation letter (redacted) if they have an existing contract clause. I'll list the exact artifacts we can attach.

Samir Patel: Repro for the 401 they saw when exporting logs — they tried a cross-org download via the admin export UI which returns 401 if the API key isn't scoped. Minimal repro snippet they provided: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/logs/export \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"org_id":"jupiterbank-prod","from":"2025-12-01","to":"2025-12-07"}'
```
If key belongs to an org without export permission you'll get `401 Unauthorized`. Recommend we include scoped instructions for the customer to avoid false positives.

Priya Nair: Good, add a one-line note for the support doc: "If you see 401 when requesting exports, confirm API key org scope and admin export role." I'll loop in the customer to confirm which org they're using. Also they asked for a sample that includes a key-rotation event and a failed access attempt next to it.

Matt Chen: Draft JSONL sample I'll post below (will be scrubbed):
```
{"ts":"2025-11-30T22:03:12Z","event_type":"kms.rotate_key","actor":"system","resource":"kms/key/rdw-1234","request_id":"req_01A2B3","details":{"old_key_id":"rdw-1233","new_key_id":"rdw-1234","rotation_reason":"scheduled","success":true}}
{"ts":"2025-11-30T22:05:01Z","event_type":"auth.failed","actor":"user:redacted","resource":"api/token/issue","request_id":"req_01A2B4","details":{"source_ip":"REDACTED","ua":"REDACTED","reason":"invalid_credentials"}}
```
This shows rotation then a failed access attempt; fields match SC audit requirements.

Igor Kuznetsov: That's perfect. For artifacts list to attach to SIG: (1) redacted audit-log sample (JSONL) (2) KMS rotation metadata CSV (key_id, created_at, rotated_at, rotation_type) (3) key policy excerpt (redacted) (4) attestation summary for Hosted or letter for Dedicated customers (if contract allows). I'll prepare wording that clarifies Hosted limitations.

security-bot: Checklist created: [x] redacted log sample, [ ] KMS rotation metadata, [ ] key policy excerpt, [ ] attestation summary/letter, [ ] retention statement. Link to CAIQ mapping doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/caiq-mapping

Priya Nair: Also need a short explanation of retention defaults and whether we can extend retention for this customer. Default hosted retention is 90 days for audit logs; Dedicated can configure retention per contract. Can someone confirm and add a sentence we can paste into the SIG response?

Matt Chen: Confirmed: hosted default 90 days; we can support extended retention for Dedicated via config and for Hosted we can do ad-hoc exports before retention cutoff (manual or programmatic). I'll write a 2-line pasteable blurb.

Samir Patel: One more note on the export 401 — sometimes customers hit a 401 after rotating their API key. If they rotated keys recently, ensure the new key is propagated in any automation and not pinned to old values. Add that to the troubleshooting Q&A.

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — timeline: Igor will draft artifacts list + attestation wording by EOD tomorrow; Matt will upload scrubbed JSONL sample here when ready; Samir will add the 401 troubleshooting snippet to the SIG response. I'll update the customer and push the deadline if needed. :thumbsup:

Matt Chen: Uploaded draft sample (redacted) in this thread — please review before we attach to SIG.

Igor Kuznetsov: Uploaded attestation blurb and KMS metadata template. Note: remove any device serials before sending.

Priya Nair: This is great. I'll assemble the final package and send to JupiterBank security. If they ask for HSM device certs again, I'll escalate to legal/contracts. Thanks! :wave:
